counterfactual_missing_items: history of significant acne vulgaris or rosacea
positive patch test or tuberculin skin test
decisive_items: numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate
non-pitting edema of the left periorbital region
response.rationale: The biopsy showing ectatic dermal lymphatics and blood vessels is pathognomonic for lymphangioma, directly supporting R4. R1 (lymphedema) explains non-pitting edema but lacks specific biopsy correlation consecutively. Competing diagnoses (angioedema, scleroderma, Sjögren) are contradicted by negative allergy testing, absence of inflammation, and biopsy findings.

rejected.why: Scleroderma is not supported by biopsy showing vascular ectasia; fibrosis and collagen changes are absent.
Sjögren syndrome typically involves sicca symptoms; no visual symptoms or exocrine gland findings present.
Angioedema usually is transient and often associated with urticaria or mucosal involvement; chronic non-pitting edema and ectatic lymphatics are atypical.
